definitions.gloss: notification form; official written notice; registration document
definitions.explanation: A formal document submitted to a government office, employer, or institution to officially notify them of a change in status, a request, or a declaration.

examples.japanese: {届出書|とどけでしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{転居|てんきょ}の{届出書|とどけでしょ}を{市役所|しやくしょ}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I submitted a change-of-address form to city hall.

examples.japanese: {届出書|とどけでしょ}の{記入|きにゅう}に{不備|ふび}があったため、{再提出|さいていしゅつ}を{求|もと}められた。
examples.english: Because there were errors in filling out the notification form, I was asked to resubmit it.

notes:
Composed of {届出|とどけで} (notification, filing) and {書|しょ} (document). Japanese bureaucracy relies heavily on paper forms, and there are specific {届出書|とどけでしょ} for nearly every life event and administrative action.

Common types include {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ} (marriage registration), {出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ} (birth registration), {転居届|てんきょとどけ} (change of address), and {退職届|たいしょくとどけ} (resignation notice). The word {届出書|とどけでしょ} is the generic term covering all such documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a notification form
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}に{記入|きにゅう}する: to fill out a notification form
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}の{様式|ようしき}: notification form format
- {届出書|とどけでしょ}の{控|ひかえ}: copy of a notification form

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {届|とどけ}: notification; report — shorter, more general term
- {申請書|しんせいしょ}: application form — for requesting permission or approval
- {申告書|しんこくしょ}: declaration form — especially for tax returns
